question: What ritual effect follows burying an object empowered after nine thousand chants on a road?
premises: Chanting is performed nine thousand times.
The object is accomplished by eight.
It is buried on a road and obstructs an army.
inference: Burying an object empowered by nine thousand chants and eightfold accomplishment on a road obstructs an army.
uncertainties: The meaning of vasu (eight) as an accomplishment factor is not fully specified.
plain_english: After nine thousand chants and accomplishment by eight, one should bury it on a road; then it obstructs an army.
